scope.implemented: The operating-system prefers-reduced-motion path stops repository-owned continuous motion without adding or changing visible controls.
scope.not_implemented: A visitor-operated global pause control remains interaction-design-gated and MMS-AUD-008 therefore remains open.
scope.normal_ui: No normal-mode layout, styling, content, media geometry, interaction, or control-panel composition changes.

implementation.videos: Deferred videos remain on their approved posters and make no play attempt while reduction is active. A live preference change restores only observer-active videos.
implementation.gif_loops: Each identified GIF takes one same-frame canvas snapshot inside its existing frame, then releases the animated source. Normal preference restores the original source.
implementation.v7: The V7 iframe remains on its approved poster when reduction is active before load. If already loaded, the validated visibility protocol sends false. Readiness now receives the current parent-owned visibility state.
implementation.visibility: Repository-owned loaded videos and validated embeds pause when the document becomes hidden and resume only when active, visible, and motion is allowed.
implementation.css_hooks: The smiley and exactly four Withered Green eye-roll hooks are suppressed only inside prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.
implementation.saved_source_safety: Active media state and GIF source state are held in WeakMaps rather than new serialized runtime data attributes.

results: zero play attempts across all 29 videos under Reduce Motion
all three GIF sources freeze in place and restore under normal preference
V7 stays on its poster initially and follows validated live preference visibility
normal mode retains all 27 Home videos, both Who videos, three GIFs, smiley animate=4, and four Withered Green hooks
startup state and exact 4 x 375ms sequence
compact and expanded 240-state gold parity matrices

required_preservation: 480 protected compact and expanded gold states, screenshots, and interactions
native rivers and zero page overflow
Touchbaes iPad readiness and visible-rig lifecycle
Montran range rendering and page turns

deployment.cargo_draft: separate complete-save and reload-persistence verification required

remaining_limitation: The audit issue cannot be fully closed until Ocean approves the design and placement of a visitor-operated pause-motion control. This round intentionally does not invent one.
